objective: Export the exact a651 output finalized by Leg2 from PFTL to its Ethereum-mainnet Uniswap asset before any live Uniswap action.

authority.route_identity_rule: Use the literal on-chain a651 asset id and never relabel it as A666.

asset_binding.amount_rule: Consume exactly the smallest positive a651 amount recorded by the accepted Leg2 issue receipt derived from the 10000000-pfUSDC-atom input. No amount may be inferred before that receipt exists.
asset_binding.amount_blocker: No accepted Leg2 receipt is present in the named live-demo evidence set, and this turn performs zero live reads.

profile_findings.w6_notes: W6 completion is local-only and L4 executes on a fresh local Ethereum fork.

l4_live.effect: Sells pre-existing Ethereum-mainnet a651 through Universal Router; it does not create or consume a PFTL export packet.

cli_surface.pftl_private_egress_scope: Spends one private note and credits public a651 on PFTL only; proves exact-six PFTL acceptance.
cli_surface.production_mainnet_export_verdict: No module-mode command accepts the finalized public a651 output, creates a PFTL export packet, produces a mainnet relay proof, or mints/consumes the corresponding Ethereum asset.
forbidden_substitutes: scripts/wallet_demo_uniswap_l4_live.py used against pre-existing mainnet a651 inventory

required_profile_fields: governed PFTL export profile and route identity
mainnet relay or ingestion finality policy
maximum proof age in PFTL blocks
Ethereum RPC class restricted to mainnet
required_command_stages: PFTL a651 export burn-or-lock using the accepted Leg2 output and exact amount
export packet finality with packet id, commitment root, block height, and profile identity
detached content-addressed proof generation for waits exceeding ten minutes
Ethereum-mainnet consume or mint bound to the exact packet and proof
post-transaction PFTL and Ethereum conservation verification
required_signer_boundaries: PFTL holder signs only the export operation through its wallet custody path
Ethereum relay signer is referenced by configured vault label or file path at use-time
no credential value enters public artifacts or command lines
missing_production_contract.estimated_gap: Production command/config integration required; a packet cannot safely invent these pins or substitute the existing inventory-only Uniswap script.

checks: Leg2 accepted receipt and six-way finality identify the exact positive a651 output
governed export route is live, unpaused, invariant-holding, and bound to literal a651
destination chain reports Ethereum chain id 1
destination contract bytecode and configured identity match canonical pins
canonical PFTL binary and export proof program/VK hashes match release evidence
current NAV, reserve proof, supply, and export entitlement are fresh and mutually consistent
Ethereum signer has at least the semantic ETH gas floor derived by the production exporter
campaign spend projection remains within the configured cap
no endpoint or artifact references Sepolia, testnet, Anvil, a fork, or local_l4
all six PFTL RPCs agree before signing and mempools are empty

stop_rule: STOP-no-retry on any mismatch. Never substitute local_l4, Anvil, a fork, Sepolia, a testnet, or pre-existing Ethereum inventory for the missing export path.
